rationale: Builds directly on the current best by keeping the winning mild QK increase but distributing it across depth: earlier blocks start slightly softer and later blocks slightly sharper. This is a compile-stable initialization-only change with no extra parameters or hot-loop cost, aimed at preserving early-layer mixing while giving late layers more selectivity within the same 600-second budget and size envelope.
title: Depth-Ramped QK Gain On Bigram64 Best
